_comment: Foundation checker stage (Objective 8). The system recommends a shade from the detected skin tone and confirms readiness only - it does not verify the shade actually used, and provides no AR guide for foundation. Slot 5 is reserved for foundation on the product tray. All shades are Detail Cosmetics Fresh Filter (natural finish foundation); shade names and undertones follow Detail's official shade descriptions. Hex values are approximations of each described shade and should be replaced with values sampled from the official swatch image once available. Detail notes the formula oxidizes slightly and advises 1-2 shades lighter than usual. Verify shade names against your physical tray inventory before evaluation.
